author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: youyeetoo has updated its R1 single-board computer to version 3.0 and has also listed the K1, a palm-sized x86 edge computer based on Intel’s Alder Lake-N N100 processor. title: youyeetoo updates R1 SBC and lists K1 N100-based x86 computer
